title: S3 objects and buckets
summary: Amazon S3 stores objects inside buckets. An object has a key, which is its name within a bucket. Slashes in keys can look like folders.
introduction: Amazon S3 stores objects inside buckets. An object has a key, which is its name within a bucket. Slashes in keys can look like folders. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.title: S3 objects and buckets

blocks.text: The bucket groups objects; the key identifies one object. Bucket names follow service-wide naming rules.

blocks.text: Do not make a bucket public just to work around an access error.
